verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's marketing says it offers APIs to connect the mailbox to other tools, so a machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, a developer portal, or any downloadable API definition. Having an API is a related feature, not proof of a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
